description: This file defines a JavaScript module for creating time series charts using the d3 and metrics-graphics libraries, specifically within the 'd3.goteo' namespace. It includes a function 'timemetricsChart' that generates configurable time-based data visualizations.

methods.name: timemetricsChart
methods.description: Creates a configurable time series chart with options for dimensions, title, description, date range, format, and data field.
